text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket ran with all her might, but 
she was unable to conquer the Japanese 
Derby.

Winning Ticket weeps uncontrollably out of 
frustration over not being able to fulfill 
her dream.

Her mind settled, she regained her 
spirits, believing that despite the loss, 
she must have delivered an "awesome race" 
to her fans.

With a smile on her face, she declares 
that she will put on an amazing 
performance in her next race, the Kikuka 
Sho, as well.
